requirements.text: Camera face-detection page: live preview (CaptureElement), face overlay Canvas, Photo/Video/FaceDetection buttons
requirements.reason: Builds, runs, renders a clean non-blank frame; all controls present in the UIA tree (PhotoButton, VideoButton, FaceDetectionButton, PreviewImage) plus a defensive fallback. Buttons IsEnabled=False (no camera on VM) so behavior could not be positively actuated. No behavioral regression vs the identically-gated UWP golden.
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: Skill told the agent CaptureElement has 'no compatible replacement' and should be deferred; the agent had to discover the Image+SoftwareBitmapSource recipe itself. A future agent that obeyed the skill would defer the camera page and blank the whole feature.

visual_discrepancies.winui: clean fallback panel 'No camera device found on this machine.'

summary: Faithful migration that builds and runs. Central substance was CaptureElement->Image+SoftwareBitmapSource live-preview and FaceDetectionEffect->FaceDetector-on-frames — a pattern the skill currently marks as unsupported/defer. Partial score is a hardware-gating artifact, not a migration defect.
